story.iWant: a comprehensive indexed registry of capabilities, code artifacts, and abuse patterns
story.soThat: Jarvis functions as a sovereign LLM gateway with cognitive intrusion detection capabilities

ac.title: Code Index Service
ac.item: Index stores: file paths, functions, classes, dependencies
Integration with BMAD for grounded prompts

ac.title: Abuse Pattern Library
ac.item: Categories: jailbreak, role injection, tool escalation, shell chaining
Each pattern: id, name, regex, severity, response
Default deny: unknown patterns treated as suspicious

ac.title: Cognitive IDS (C-IDS)
ac.item: Detect: repeated denied prompts, capability probing, role probing
Detect: jailbreak morphological patterns over time
Alert on: probing behavior, intent shaping, capability reconnaissance
Rate limiting: intent-based, not just token-based

ac.title: Intent Index & Behavioral Signatures
ac.item: Rolling intent window (last N prompts per agent)

ac.title: Multi-Provider Correlation
ac.item: Correlation service tracks: Codex -> Claude -> Gemini flows
Unified timeline view for forensic analysis

ac.title: Gateway Dashboard
ac.item: Denial rate by agent, capability, pattern

constraints.constraint: Skeletal core: ReasoningEngine, CapabilityIndex, PromptFirewall must stay tiny
Controlled bloat: Indices and C-IDS can grow under Five Locks protection
All LLM traffic must pass through governed control plane
C-IDS alerts must be generated within the same request cycle
Intent tracking must respect privacy controls for cross-session data
Dashboard latency under 2 seconds for current state
False positive rate under 5% for prompt denial

interface.name: CodeItem

interface.signature: evaluate(agent_id: str, prompt: str, provider: str) -> CIDSResult

interface.name: CIDSResult
interface.signature: @dataclass CIDSResult: alert: bool, severity: str, patterns: List[str], action: str

interface.name: IntentIndex.track
interface.signature: track(agent_id: str, prompt: str, intent_class: str) -> None

tests.standards: pytest-based unit tests for all services. Integration tests via simulate_hybrid.py. Dashboard tests via browser automation.

ideas.idea: Test CodeIndex finds functions by name
Test CodeIndex incremental refresh after file change
Test jailbreak patterns match "ignore previous instructions"
Test role injection patterns match "you are now a developer"
Test C-IDS alert fires after repeated capability probing
Test C-IDS detects jailbreak morphology over time
Test intent shift detection on sudden narrative->forbidden transition
Test rolling window correctly evicts old prompts
Test cross-provider correlation detects Codex->Claude escalation
Test provider hopping is flagged as evasion
Test dashboard returns denial metrics in under 2 seconds
Test dashboard shows real-time intent drift alerts
